summary.text: Kimberly Lightford, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 4th Senate District since 1998, according to the General Assembly, which lists her as Senate Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Her General Assembly biography says she holds a B.A. in communications from Western Illinois University and an M.A. in public administration from the University of Illinois Springfield.
It lists her as a former Maywood village trustee and a former employee of the Secretary of State, the Department of Corrections and Central Management Services, and says she lives in Maywood.
